author: justaddwater.dk | Attending UI11 Conference next week
html: \[...\] It’s a hard dilemma to choose between tracks, especially at this conference. For example, I chose Luke Wroblewski over Jeff Patton’s “Bringing User-Centered Design Practices into Agile Development Projects” . Also, Rolf Molich’s sessions were already filled up, so my options were narrowed down. I saw Rolf last year at “Usability Dagene” (my notes), and he is always interesting and insightful. \[...\]

author: justaddwater.dk | Usability Test Results Too Diverse?
html: \[...\] Well, oddly enough, I remember that Rolf put it differently at the Danish usability conference a year ago. At that time his conclusion was to test with 50 users. This is what I wrote after his presentation: Five users are not enough to catch 85% of the usability problems. \[...\]
